cycles.title: Genesis positive-only obstruction
cycles.purpose: Test the shortest C015 SAT anti-checker funnel under the strongest elementary adversary before investing in construction.
cycles.result: The all-accepting circuit decisively destroys H112 and H113. H116 preserves the one-sided witness idea only under an explicit SAT-soundness promise.
cycles.claim_boundary: C016 does not resolve P versus NP. It removes an invalid shortcut and narrows the direct SAT route.
